_note: Transcription of the exact Railway Template Composer settings for the PostgreSQL 19 + pgvector template. Railway does NOT read this file automatically: enter these settings in the Template Composer when publishing, and check the published page against this file. The service builds from the GitHub repo's Dockerfile (our own image from PGDG packages); there is no upstream Docker image to reference.
category_note: Railway's category list has no 'Database' option (checked 2026-11-03); Storage is the closest available filing.
description: PostgreSQL 19.0 with pgvector 0.8.7, ready to deploy
name: PostgreSQL 19 + pgvector
notIncluded: Backups (snapshot the volume or run pg_dump on a schedule)
TLS inside the container (prefer Railway private networking)

healthcheck.note: Database services have no HTTP healthcheck path. Health is proven by an authenticated psql connection (SELECT 1) plus a pgvector query, as in scripts/local-test.sh, not by process liveness alone.

source.note: Builds the repo Dockerfile (debian:trixie-slim + pinned PGDG packages).

tcpProxy.note: Enable the TCP proxy so users can connect from outside Railway; service-to-service traffic uses the private domain.

PGURL.note: Connection string for other services in the same project.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.note: Generated at deploy time by the template secret() function (the form proven on the Laravel AI SDK template). Never a literal value.

volumes.note: Persistent volume; the image sets PGDATA here. Without it, data is lost on redeploy.

stillUntestedAtPublish: Live Railway deploy of this template (the live test runs right after publishing and this file is updated with the result)
